summary: Troy Green, 39, of San Antonio, TX — reported missing after he failed to contact his wife on Thu Jan 31 and missed a Denver conference; his rental car was found early Fri Feb 1 at the Bear Lake parking lot in RMNP. Multi-day search (35-45 searchers, dog teams, helicopter; Larimer County SAR, Rocky Mountain Rescue, Douglas County SAR, Arapahoe Rescue Patrol, Summit County Rescue) scaled back Mon Feb 4 amid deep snow and avalanche conditions; body found Tue Feb 5 by two snowshoers ~100 ft off trail near the Flattop Mountain Trail, recovered to Bear Lake Trailhead; believed to be Green (Larimer County Coroner autopsy pending).
location: Bear Lake area, Rocky Mountain National Park
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park rangers; Larimer County Search and Rescue
notes: Last spoken with 1 p.m. Thu Jan 31 at Bear Lake Trailhead; last heard from by wife Thu Jan 31; search ran Fri Feb 1 - Mon Feb 4 (scaled back Feb 4); wore black snow pants, black puffy down jacket, black balaclava, royal blue/grey Camelback pack; body found against a tree ~1 mi north of Tyndall Gorge/Nymph Lake focus area. NPS ROMO morning-report compendium URL merged (run 487). SARDOC 2013 mission report (dog-team assist; frames Green as apparently suicidal) merged run 567.
